scene1.text: What if your next brand ambassador wasn't human?

scene2.text: AI influencers are already attracting audiences and landing brand deals.

scene3.text: Fast Company profiled Aitana Lopez, a virtual creator with hundreds of thousands of followers.

scene4.text: New tools can also let businesses create a digital character and place it into product videos.

scene5.text: That gives marketers another way to test creative ideas without filming every version from scratch.

scene6.text: But attention doesn't guarantee sales. And a fictional character presented as a real customer can mislead viewers.

scene7.text: The smart move? Use AI characters to test ideas, and be transparent about what people are watching.
